summary: GFL Environmental filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 12, 2026 press release announcing that HPS Investment Partners, on behalf of holders of GFL's Series A perpetual convertible preferred shares, gave notice to convert 4,867,006 preferred shares into 6,219,896 subordinate voting shares, leaving no Series A Preferred outstanding. HPS-managed funds then sold the converted shares in a block trade at US$42.73 per share. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date is stated. The event is a preferred-to-equity conversion plus secondary block sale, eliminating the preferred overhang and enlarging the free float rather than a merger or tender. Watch post-block selling pressure and any change to the share count and index weightings.
